title: aptmagic
body:
Just new, beautiful ingots without crafting These ingots were created for build creators who can clearly come up with something with them

1. Adamant Scrap Metal
2. Adamant Ingot
3. Adamant Mana Ingot (blue)
4. Adamant Ghost Ingot (green)
5. Adamant Alchemical Ingot (purple)
6. Adamant Dragon Ingot (orange)

this is my first mod, so don't judge me too harshly
